notes: Model name "10G2F" denotes port count (10x RJ45 + 2x Fiber/SFP), not 10-Gigabit speed — all RJ45 and SFP ports on this specific model are Gigabit (1G), confirmed by the manufacturer datasheet's "10/100/1000 BASE-T RJ45 ports" and "1000BASE-X SFP ports" columns (distinct from the 10G-capable M4250-10G2XF-PoE+ sibling model). Ports 1-8 (RJ45) are PoE+ (802.3at, 30W/port, 125W total budget); ports 9-10 (RJ45) are data-only; ports 11-12 are 1G SFP slots (transceivers sold separately, not counted as physical device ports here). Console access is dual: RJ45 RS232 (DB9 adapter cable included) and USB-C; a USB-A port is provided for local storage/logs (not a host data port, included for completeness as bidirectional per USB convention). Power is a single fixed IEC C14 inlet with integrated on/off rocker switch (region-specific power cord included, no external power brick). Rack unit height is 1U (43.2mm) per Netgear's official Hardware-at-a-Glance table.

ports.name: Power
ports.note: Fixed IEC power inlet with on/off switch; datasheet lists as 'Fixed (C14)' — physically this is the 3-pin IEC C14 male inlet (mates with a C13 cord). No connector id for IEC C13/14 exists separate from 'iec' in the given list, so 'iec' (C13/14 family) was used as closest match rather than iec-c5/c7.
